title: Poeti d'Italia in lingua latina (MQDQ)
institution: Università Ca' Foscari Venezia, Università di Padova, Università di Trieste, Università di Verona (MQDQ project; PRIN 1999 and 2001)
notes: Digital library of Latin verse written in Italy from Dante's time to the mid-16th century, with metrical scansion, a search tool, co-occurrence search and indexes of authors, metres and works. The text of each poem is freely readable and is taken from a named modern critical edition (for example L. Capra 1973 for Leonardo Teronda). The chronological index lists 346 authors in three periods: 'Da Dante a Petrarca' (1250-1374, 76 authors), 'Umanisti del Quattrocento' (1374-1494, 172) and 'Prima metà del Cinquecento' (1494-1550, 98). Texts and words are left out because the share dated 1450-1700 could not be separated without counting every work; the site states 'Ultimo aggiornamento: 2026.06.03'. Because the texts reproduce modern critical editions of poems that survive in manuscripts and prints, they are not diplomatic transcriptions.
